description: Create, read, update, delete, list, and search CRM records (contacts, companies, deals, leads) in a JSON-backed store.
name: crm_record
provider_notes: Local JSON-backed store via ctx.memory (scoped key aul:crm_records_v1). No external CRM provider integrated; connector to Salesforce/HubSpot would be a future provider behind ctx.auth_get. Demo runs against an in-memory FakeCtx, clearly labeled.
